#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    int n;
    string z;
    cin >> n >> z;
    
    int k = 0, count = 0, outsideMax = 0, insideWords = 0;
    int i = 0;
    
    while (i < n) {
        char c = z[i];
        i++;
        
        if (c == '_') {
            if (k == 0) {
                if (count > outsideMax) outsideMax = count;
            } else {
                if (count > 0) insideWords++;
            }
            count = 0;
        } else if (c == '(') {
            k = 1;
            if (count > outsideMax) outsideMax = count;
            count = 0;
        } else if (c == ')') {
            k = 0;
            if (count > 0) insideWords++;
            count = 0;
        } else {
            count++;
        }
    }
    
    if (k == 0 && count > outsideMax) outsideMax = count;
    
    cout << outsideMax << " " << insideWords << endl;
    
    return 0;
}
